The record is active in the system

There are two methods of making records unavailable in the system: One is to delete the record, the other is to de-activate the record. A de-activated record is not available for selection, but available for reports. There are two reasons for de-activating and not deleting records: (1) The system requires the record for audit purposes. (2) The record is referenced by other records. E.g., you cannot delete a Business Partner, if there are invoices for this partner record existing. You de-activate the Business Partner and prevent that this record is used for future entries.
A Client is a company or a legal entity. You cannot share data between Clients. Tenant is a synonym for Client.

Step.SQLStatement: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW RV_ForecastComparison AS SELECT fc.M_ForecastComparison_ID, fc.AD_Org_ID, fc.ForecastLevel, fc.C_Period_ID, fc.M_Forecast_ID, fc.M_ForecastLine_ID, fc.SalesRep_ID, fc.M_Product_ID, fc.C_BPartner_ID, fc.ComparisonSource, -- Quantities fc.QtyForecast, fc.QtyActual, fc.QtyVariance, -- Amounts fc.AmtForecast, fc.AmtActual, fc.AmtVariance, fc.VariancePct, -- KPI Metrics fc.ForecastAccuracy, fc.Bias, fc.MAD, fc.MAPE, -- Product Groupings fc.M_Brand_ID, fc.M_Product_Category_ID, fc.M_Product_Class_ID, fc.M_Product_Classification_ID, fc.M_Product_Group_ID, fc.M_Material_Group_ID, fc.M_Material_Type_ID, fc.M_Industry_Sector_ID, fc.M_PartType_ID, fc.M_FreightCategory_ID, fc.M_Purchase_Group_ID, fc.M_Sales_Group_ID, -- Budget fc.C_SalesBudgetLine_ID, -- Control fc.RequiresReview, fc.DateCalculated, fc.IsActive, fc.AD_Client_ID FROM M_ForecastComparison fc;
